lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 9 distinct vertical white lines; spacing is relatively uniform with a slight increase in width (approx 1.2x) in the mid-torso region compared to the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A single Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the 4th line from the posterior, located approximately 20% down from the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line 1 (most posterior), line 2, and line 9 (anterior) appear as abbreviated segments that do not extend the full height of the torso mass.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two high-contrast circular spots located on the posterior haunch, arranged in a vertical orientation.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate/spiral trajectory with a lateral outward vector at the base transitioning to a medial inward vector towards the terminal tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The estimated pixel distance between the horn tips is 0.85x the total width of the horn base structure.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping represents approximately 12-15% of the total visible horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: White facial chevron between the eyes; two white spots on the lower mandible; white dorsal mane along the spine; long dark ventral hair fringe; orange-tan coloration on all four limbs starting below the knee/elbow joints.
